MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  JANUARY 16, 2024

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  A special meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
  was called to order at 7:01 p.m. at City of Rolling Hills Estates Council Chambers, 4045
  Palos Verdes Dr. N., Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR BAIN.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR BAIN led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Pope, Ciarolla, Johnson, McCormick and Bain

  Commissioners Absent:  Persichina and Holdsworth

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  PRESENTATION

  NONE.

  5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF
  DECEMBER 18, 2023

  VICE CHAIR MCCORMICK made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  POPE to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  DECEMBER 18, 2023.

  There being no objection, CHAIR BAIN so ordered.

  6.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  NONE.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  1
JANUARY 16, 2024
   A.  2024 COUNCIL MEETING ATTENDANCE SCHEDULE

  Coordinator Morrow gave a brief overview of the 2024 Council Meeting Attendance
  Schedule (as per the agenda material).

  The Commission concurred that they would notify Staff if they would be unable to
  attend any meetings they have been assigned.

  B.  2024 COMMITTEE, SUBCOMMITTEE, ADOPT-A-PARK ASSIGNMENTS

  Supervisor Pinuelas requested that the item be tabled to the February Commission
  meeting due to two Commissioners being absent. The Commission agreed.

  C.  2024 CONCERT IN THE PARK MUSIC GENRE SELECTION (VERBAL REPORT)

  For Commission’s consideration, Coordinator Morrow suggested different music
  genres for the 2024 Concert in the Park event on August 17.

  A discussion ensued among the Commission about genres available. It was also
  suggested to have a music group with children’s participation as an opening act or
  even a youth battle of the bands. A Country band was decided as the first option
  for Staff to begin their search.

  **ADJOURN TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING AT 7:11
  PM**

  D.  ROLLING HILLS ESTATES EVENT SPONSORSHIP PROGRAM

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the Rolling Hills Estates event
  sponsorship program (as per the agenda material).

  In response to CHAIR BAIN, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Staff had not received
  any interest recently with sponsorships at the $250 sponsor level for the City
  Celebration event. She also stated that it would hopefully add extra interest for the
  $500 sponsorship level.

  CHAIR BAIN suggested adding some kind of incentive for sponsors to commit
  earlier as a sponsor. Supervisor Pinuelas noted that Staff has added some of these
  incentives but will continue to look at some other incentives for businesses to
  commit to sponsorship sooner.

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  2
JANUARY 16, 2024
   VICE CHAIR MCCORMICK suggested having a package option for a business that
  typically sponsors multiple events to encourage sponsoring all the events with some
  kind of discount involved for an all-event sponsorship.

  **RECONVENE PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING AT 7:17 PM**

  8.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  COMMUNITY SERVICES DEPARTMENT PUBLIC OUTREACH

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief overview of the Community Services Department
  public outreach (as per the agenda material).

  COMMISSIONER POPE noted that the outreach numbers looked good, and that
  the current sponsorship packet should be updated to reflect these numbers.
  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Staff would update the packet with the current
  outreach numbers before sending out the 2024 event sponsorship information.

  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that each event budget has its own marketing budget
  that is tailored to whichever marketing platform works best for that event, in
  response to CHAIR BAIN.

  Supervisor Pinuelas affirmed that the outreach numbers, especially the subscriber
  numbers have grown each year, in response to VICE CHAIR MCCORMICK.

  CHAIR BAIN asked if the City should run a marketing campaign to assist in
  increasing the followers and subscribers of the City’s social media platforms and
  newsletters. Supervisor Pinuelas stated that during standard marketing for events
  typically the City’s social media platforms are listed for people to join and follow.
  She also noted that Staff is working on methods to help increase followers and
  subscribers for these platforms.

  VICE CHAIR MCCORMICK asked if people opt in to receive emails from the City
  regarding future events. Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Staff will confirm that there
  is specific verbiage indicating that a participant may receive emails from the City
  marketing future events.

  COMMISSIONER JOHNSON suggested including a QR code for the City’s social
  media platforms that people can scan when marketing events.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  3
JANUARY 16, 2024
   Supervisor Pinuelas shared that the Mayor’s Ride date was changed to Saturday,
  May 11, which was reported as a better option for the local Scout troops for the
  pancake breakfast portion of the event.

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER JOHNSON reported that there were no concerns with
  Dapplegray Park.

  CHAIR BAIN commended Staff on the clean-up of the weeds at Highridge Park.
  She also noted that the gophers appear to be overtaking the park. Superintendent
  Goldsmith stated that as of February 1, there will be a new vendor handling the
  gopher control at the parks. CHAIR BAIN also noted that there are some deep
  gullies forming in the walking trails around the park. Superintendent Goldsmith
  stated that Staff is in the process of repairing the walking trails. Lastly, CHAIR BAIN
  stated that there still appears to be an issue with unleashed dogs at Highridge Park
  and suggested signage around the main area that the groups seem to congregate.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER POPE requested that a dog park item be added as a future
  agenda item. Supervisor Pinuelas noted that this was mentioned at the December
  meeting and has been noted internally as a future agenda item.

  VICE CHAIR MCCORMICK asked if there were any open parcels of land around
  the City to utilize as new park space. He mentioned a certain area around George
  F Canyon as a possible option. He also asked if there was a subcommittee for the
  Concert in the Park event and if not, asked if one was needed. Supervisor Pinuelas
  stated that while Staff is looking for areas around the City for dog park options, they
  will note any other possible opportunities for new park usage. She also noted that
  at this time the Concert in the Park does not have a subcommittee and that
  questions are brought to the Commission as needed but that a subcommittee could
  be formed in the future if a need for one arises.

  COMMISSIONER POPE agreed that the George F Canyon area was a good option
  for future park space.

  COMMISSIONER POPE requested an update regarding Founders Park.
  Supervisor Pinuelas stated that Staff will provide Commission an update regarding
  Founders Park at the next meeting.

  10.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  4
JANUARY 16, 2024
   A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF DECEMBER 12, 2023
  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  11.  FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  A.  SECURITY CAMERA PROJECT UPDATE

  NONE

  B.  CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT LIST

  NONE

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR BAIN ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 7:35 PM TO THE NEXT PARK AND
  ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON FEBRUARY 20, 2024, AT 7:00 P.M.,
  WHICH WILL BE HELD AT CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CITY HALL.

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  __________________________  ___________________________
  Matt Morrow  Judy Bain
  Community Services Coordinator  Chair, Park & Activities Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES MEETING MINUTES  5
JANUARY 16, 2024
